summary: This guide showcases a Thunderbolt team tackling the Fire Guardians in Season 9 Crown Contest Round 1. Despite using only Level 79 heroes and no negative runes, the team achieves over 1.44 billion total damage. The strategy exploits the boss's +30% Enlightenment Damage vulnerability by stacking full Enlightenment on Perkunte and Alaura. Additionally, building around 200 Resistance on all heroes completely counters the boss's 150 Accuracy Recharging Speed Penalty, requiring no custom skill timings.

teams.note: Full Level 79 Thunderbolt team dealing 1.44B damage with default skill timings and no negative runes by meeting a ~200 Resistance threshold across all units.

tips: Aim for around 200 Resistance on every hero to reliably resist the 150 Accuracy Recharging Speed Penalty inflicted by the Fire Guardians' Sacrifice skill.
Capitalize on Round 1's boss vulnerability (+30% Enlightenment and Necrotic damage taken) by stacking full Enlightenment on damage dealers like Perkunte.
Leave all hero ultimate skill timings on default, as custom delays or manual interventions are not required for this composition.
title: Thunderbolt Team (Lv 79) vs Fire Guardians | Crown Contest Round 1 | Dragonheir | Season 9
